newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria says Israeli PM uses security as pretext.
newsitem.headline: Syria says Israeli PM uses security as pretext.

text.p: Syrian official newspapers on Monday accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of using the security issue to keep Arab lands the Jewish state occupied in 1967.
"Netanyahu not only hates the idea of real peace but also stubbornly rejects the requirements of real security which provides stability, tranquility and peace for everybody," Tishreen newspaper said.
"The reason for Netanyahu's rejection of real and equal peace is his wish not to return the Arab usurped rights and not to stop the aggressive and expansionist tendency in Israeli policy," it added.

"Netanyahu not only demands that Palestinians forget their usurped rights, turn a blind eye to swallowing of the remaining of their land, but also to guard the security of the occupiers....," it said.
"And if any Palestinian did anything against Israel, then the punishment would fall on all of the Palestinians and they would become terrorists in the view of Netanyahu."
"Real security cannot be achieved in isolation from comprehensive and just peace. Moreover, it is a result of this peace," Tishreen said.

The Baath ruling party newspaper said U.S. envoy Dennis Ross was focusing on solving security issues before resuming peace talks. It said this contradicted U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright's remarks that peace should be based on the land-for-peace principle.

"The American diplomat concentrated in his statements on commitment to the peace process while considering security as a primary component to achieve peace...and that contradicts the understanding of just and comprehensive peace,` al-Baath said.

It said the results of Ross's visit "would be slim if he continued putting security before peace, which means continuing not to remove the Israeli causes that generate violence and escalation, such as settlements in Jerusalem".
